question: Can a constitution be uncodified yet written in several legal sources? Give the named example.

draft.raw: O1|P2.2|United Kingdom|2026-10-01|The constitution of the United Kingdom is an example of an uncodified constitution that is written in numerous fundamental acts of a legislature, court cases, and treaties.

claims.subject: United Kingdom
claims.text: The constitution of the United Kingdom is an example of an uncodified constitution that is written in numerous fundamental acts of a legislature, court cases, and treaties.

references.label: P2.2
references.text: The constitution of the United Kingdom is a notable example of an uncodified constitution; it is instead written in numerous fundamental acts of a legislature, court cases, and treaties.[2]
